evaluator.name: Codex plus deterministic validators and in-app browser proof

contractChecks.evidence: Phase A round 02 is active at its own human gate and Phase B is held until the visual lock.
One portrait component anatomy remains recognisable across four role-based treatments and real website placements.
Light and charcoal are allocated by component role rather than by a superficial global theme toggle.
The shelf compares products and the bundle sells one package with subordinate inclusions.
Discovery, feature, pricing, checkout, bundle, upsell, mobile summary, states and responsive behavior are explicit website deliverables.
The focal treatment mounted the shared Living Core after canonical paths were corrected; exact static fallback remains configured.
Contract, package and review payload retain productionAuthority false and keep functional implementation held.
H-EXP-04A-CARD-VISUAL-DIRECTION has not yet been decided for round 02.

qualityDimensions.evidence: The proof directly states and demonstrates that the reviewed object is a real website product card.
Four treatments retain a stable anatomy and have explicit contextual jobs.
Base, focal, dense and commerce treatments plus shelf and bundle semantics cover the useful visual range without dead concepts.
Compact and tablet layouts recompose in source order with narrower cards and no intentional horizontal component scrolling.
Round 01 rejection is recorded, Phase B scope is explicit, and the human gate remains non-authoritative.

notes: Machine and browser proof pass. Human critique of round 02 is required before another Phase A iteration or any Phase B component implementation.
